spec:
  replicas: 1   # temporary -- KEDA takes over
  template:
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload-type: gpu-inference
      containers:
        - name: triton
          readinessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
          resources:
            limits:
              nvidia.com/gpu: 1
caption: Same GPU constraints as Chapter 4 -- but replicas stop being this Deployment's job next.

code:
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
spec:
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 8
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  triggers:
    - type: prometheus   # 0 -> 1
      metadata:
        metricName: inference_queue_depth
        threshold: "1"
    - type: prometheus   # 1 -> many
      metadata:
        metricName: DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL
        threshold: "70"
caption: Queue depth decides if any replica should exist; GPU utilization decides how many beyond one.
